name: Al Rios
office: City of South Gate, Member of the City Council

items.text: Al Rios is the Vice Mayor and a member of the South Gate City Council, first elected in 2017. He also works as Dean of Academic Affairs and a professor of political science at East Los Angeles College. At the college, his official biography says he helped create a student shuttle to the main campus.
